## Libraries
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
library(elevatr)     # elevation data download
library(tigris)      # US Census boundary data
library(viridisLite)
```

## Data Details & Processing
```{r}
# Sea Surface Temperature data
sst_08 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
sst_09 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
sst_10 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
sst_11 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
sst_12 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')

sst_raster<- (c(sst_08, sst_09, sst_10, sst_11, sst_12)) #Stack rasters 

sst_mean<- mean(sst_raster, na.rm = TRUE) #Take the mean of the rasters and convert to celcius

SST <- sst_mean - 273.15
# Bathymetry data
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')

# Exclusive Economic Zones
wc_regions <- read_sf('data/wc_regions_clean.shp')
```

```{r}
# crop raster to extent of vector object
depth_cropped <- crop(depth, SST)
```

```{r}
depth_resampl <- terra::resample(depth_cropped, y = SST, method = "bilinear")
plot(depth_resampl)
plot(SST)
```

```{r}
cat("=== SST ===\n")
cat("Resolution:", res(SST), "\n")
cat("Extent:    "); print(ext(SST))

cat("\n=== Depth Resample ===\n")
cat("Resolution:", res(depth_resampl), "\n")
cat("Extent:    "); print(ext(depth_resampl))


cat("\n=== Same CRS? ===\n")
cat("SST vs Depth Resample: ", same.crs(SST, depth_resampl), "\n")
```

```{r}
if(st_crs(SST) == st_crs(depth_resampl)){
  print("it's a match!")
} else {
  print("still not a match")
}
SST <- project(SST, crs(depth_resampl))
```

## Find suitable locations

Research has shown that oysters need the following conditions for optimal growth:

    sea surface temperature: 11-30°C
    depth: 0-70 meters below sea level

```{r}

# Define a reclassification matrix for temperature
rcl_sst <- matrix(c(-Inf, 11, 0, # not suitable
                11, 30, 1,  # suitable
                30, Inf, 0), # not suitable
              ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1 or 2
sst_rcl <- terra::classify(SST, rcl = rcl_sst)

# Define a reclassification matrix for temperature
rcl_depth <- matrix(c(-Inf, 0, 0, # not suitable
                0, 70, 1,  # suitable
                70, Inf, 0), # not suitable
              ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1 or 2
depth_rcl <- terra::classify(depth_resampl, rcl = rcl_depth)

combined <- c(sst_rcl, depth_rcl)

suitable_zones <- lapp(combined, fun = function(SST,depth) SST * depth)
plot(suitable_zones)
```

## Determine the most suitable EEZ

```{r}
ezz_raster <- rasterize(wc_regions, suitable_zones, field = 'rgn_id')
plot(ezz_raster)

suitable_cellsize <- cellSize(suitable_zones, unit = "km", mask = TRUE)

plot(suitable_cellsize)

suitable_zone_mask <- mask(suitable_cellsize, suitable_zones, maskvalues = 0)
plot(suitable_zone_mask)

zone <- zonal(suitable_zone_mask, ezz_raster, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

zone_tibble <- as_tibble(zone)

eez_map <- left_join(wc_regions,zone_tibble, by= 'rgn_id')

tm_shape(eez_map) +
    tm_basemap('OpenStreetMap')+
    tm_fill(fill='area')
```

## Develop Function
```{r}
Species_EEZ <- function(minimum_sst,maximum_sst,minimum_depth,maximum_depth,
species_name) {
    rcl_sst <- matrix(c(-Inf, minimum_sst, 0, # not suitable
                    minimum_sst, maximum_sst, 1,  # suitable
                    maximum_sst, Inf, 0), # not suitable
                ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

    # Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1 or 2
    sst_rcl <- terra::classify(SST, rcl = rcl_sst)

    # Define a reclassification matrix for temperature
    rcl_depth <- matrix(c(-Inf, minimum_depth, 0, # not suitable
                    minimum_depth, maximum_depth, 1,  # suitable
                    maximum_depth, Inf, 0), # not suitable
                ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

    # Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1 or 2
    depth_rcl <- terra::classify(depth_resampl, rcl = rcl_depth)

    combined <- c(sst_rcl, depth_rcl)

    suitable_zones <- lapp(combined, fun = function(SST,depth) SST * depth)

    ezz_raster <- rasterize(wc_regions, suitable_zones, field = 'rgn_id')

    suitable_cellsize <- cellSize(suitable_zones, unit = "km", mask = TRUE)

    suitable_zone_mask <- mask(suitable_cellsize, suitable_zones, maskvalues = 0)

    zone <- zonal(suitable_zone_mask, ezz_raster, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

    zone_tibble <- as_tibble(zone)

    eez_map <- left_join(wc_regions,zone_tibble, by= 'rgn_id')

    tm_shape(eez_map) +
    tm_basemap('OpenStreetMap')+
    tm_fill(fill='area')
}
```

## Apply Function
```{r}
Species_EEZ(minimum_sst = 11, maximum_sst = 30,
            minimum_depth = -70, maximum_depth = 0,
            species_name = "Oysters")
```
```{r}
Species_EEZ(minimum_sst = 15, maximum_sst = 30,
            minimum_depth = -20, maximum_depth = 0,
            species_name = "california_datemussel")
```
